long_biography.plain_text:
The 1995 ownership change at Winchester Capital marked a decisive transition for Ceasar Nicholas Anquillare. When Pamela Harriman became United States ambassador to France, he and London colleagues acquired the business that he had launched with her family office nine years earlier. Winchester then expanded its cross-border research and advised on large private-equity portfolio transactions.

Anquillare combined firm leadership with roles beyond Winchester. He advised on technology investments, joined boards of companies listed in London and New York, and helped guide BritishAmerican Business. Winchester also evolved into a family office that manages its own capital through closed-end fund and exchange-traded fund strategies. The work preserved a finance career linking New Haven and London.
